children: German media and services group Bertelsmann
raised its 2026 outlook on Friday, citing a positive business performance and M&A activity.
It now expects strong revenue growth and significant growth in its adjusted operating EBITDA, after previously guiding for both metrics to be stable.

It reported first-half adjusted operating earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation of €1.31 billion ($1.53 billion) for the year, compared with 1.25 billion in the first half of 2025.
